title: Joke Workshop
description: Choose a setup, pick a surprising ending or record your own, then perform it on a friendly paper stage.
learningGoals: Understand that jokes have setups and surprising endings
Compose and share a short original ending
interactionModel: Directly choose one of three picture punchlines or record an original punchline, followed by an automatic stage performance
feedbackModel: Every ending is warmly celebrated by the audience video, with a Comedian Star. Picture endings are saved in the Joke Book; recordings stay local to the active performance.

modes.title: Picture Punchlines
modes.skill: anticipate a surprising ending from an oral setup

modes.title: Record My Own
modes.skill: compose and share a short original ending aloud

persistence: localStorage Joke Book stores picture-punchline entries and an integer Comedian Star count; recorded original punchlines play locally for the current performance and are not uploaded.
stage: Direct picture selection or a microphone recording opens the neutral audience panel; the narrator says the setup and punchline, then a local laugh or confused reaction video plays. Classic endings and recordings get audience-laugh; alternate endings get audience-confused, followed by confetti and the star reward.
credits: Papercraft art is locally generated and curated; fixed narration uses a locally generated comedian-reference voice pack, with device Web Speech for child-authored text and resilient fallback.
